# Instructions for Copilot

Read `docs/index.md` before making changes to business behavior or architecture, then read the relevant approved document it links to. Do not treat example placeholders as approved requirements. If approval or a needed rule is missing, stop and ask rather than inventing it. Keep changes within the requested scope, run relevant checks, and report what was verified versus not verified. Do not stage, commit, or push unless the project owner explicitly authorizes it.
